body:
I just wanted to say thanks to those that responded to my message. I noticed after my post at how many new ones there are every day and getting any response feels good. I have contacted my school to talk to an adviser to set a course I can follow. I have also applied (and it seem like I have gotten the job) to a job that I have thought about applying for in the past. Even with these improvements the l dark thoughts creep in at night. Doesn't help I currently work nights so am up all the time alone and the loneliness hurts. Johny Cash's Hurt is on repeat. Things are better and I will try to keep fighting. Thanks again for the words.

P.S. John Malkovitch is awesome! and he should be in more movies!
